gipsy-danger.title: Pacific Rim Soul of Chogokin GX-77 Gipsy Danger
gipsy-danger.description:
Pacific Rim Soul of Chogokin GX-77 Gipsy Danger

Product Description

Finally! Pacific Rim, the mecha masterpiece from 2013, joins the Soul of Chogokin series! The first is the lead Jaeger, Gipsy Danger! Made of diecast metal, this is the long-awaited ultimate portrayal of the titanic robot fighter.

This Pacific Rim Gipsy Danger GX-77 toy features both illumination (lights up in 3 places) and sound effects (for weapons and the start-up sequence). Included with the figure are two sets of hands, a ship, 2 chain-swords, 2 chain-whips, 2 plasma-casters, a stand, and instructions.

Product Features

  • 9.1 inches (23.114cm)
  • Made of diecast metal
  • From Pacific Rim
  • Features illumination and sound effects
  • Wide array of interchangeable parts and accessories
  • Posable action figure

Box Contents

  • Gipsy Danger figure
  • 2 Sets of hands
  • Ship
  • 2 Chain-swords
  • 2 Chain-whips
  • 2 Plasma-casters
  • Stand
  • Instructions
